name: Inferring a rule from examples
definition: You are shown a few inputs and their outputs and must work out the machine in the middle. Several rules can fit a few examples, so the test of a candidate rule is whether it explains every example given, including the awkward one.
recognizeWhen: the machine turns three into seven
work out the rule and apply it
here are some examples of the operation
which rule fits all of these
misconceptions: I found a rule that fitted the first two examples and never checked the third.
I chose the simplest rule instead of the one that fits every case.
I applied the rule backwards when the question asked for the input.
